title: HATS Deployed Agent
description: An agent as it exists inside one project. Produced by deploying an Agent Template and then applying project-local edits. The document is fully resolved — the Team Runner can embody it without contacting the Agent Template Library.

instanceId.description: Identity of this agent within this project. Also the runtime agent id used by the Embodiment API.

templateId.description: Library template this agent was deployed from. Absent for agents authored directly in the project.

templateRevision.description: Template revision at deployment time. Compare with the library to detect drift.

name.description: Name inside this project. May diverge from the template after a project-local rename.

enabled.description: False keeps the agent in the project definition but stops the Team Runner embodying it.

projectRole.description: Free-text role in this team, e.g. 'facilitator', 'risk owner'.

home.description: The project this agent belongs to. Absent means the project holding it; it differs only while the agent visits another team.

needs.description: What this agent depends on. A missing required tool is reported to the agent and the dashboard, and refuses a visit to a team without it.

required.description: MCP server ids the agent cannot do its job without.

preferred.description: MCP server ids the agent can manage without.

required.description: True refuses a visit to a team that cannot run this agent's model provider, rather than using its default model.

teamContext.description: Roster summary injected into the system prompt. Regenerated by the Team Runner when the team changes.

identity.visualDescription: poised, organised, warm presence in a tailored blazer
